answer: Require each identity to escrow a 600-unit bond and serve a thirty-one epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for thirteen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 600 units per alias and replays thirty-one rounds, while a walnut of shared traces exposes the ring, grove routing scatters tasks, and dune clusters trigger review.
